newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Memtec yr net income falls to US$7.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Memtec yr net income falls to US$7.5 mln.

text.p: Water filtration group Memtec Ltd said on Friday its full year net income was US$7.5 million, down 32 percent from the 1995/96 (July/June) result.
This was struck on annual net revenues of US$243.61 million, up from US$174.51 million in the previous corresponding period.
Fourth quarter net income was US$677,000, down from US$3.07 million previously due to writedowns of US$2.6 million relating to its French operations.
Fourth quarter net revenues were 18 percent higher at US$57.42 million.
Memtec said it expected a further restructuring charge of about US$2.3 million pre-tax in the first quarter of the current financial year.
The company said the restructuring will focus the French operations on global brands and away from the non-core engineering businesses previously conducted exclusively in France.
By 2.40 p.m. (0440 GMT), Memtec shares were A$2.85 higher at A$34.85 on just five trades totalling 541 shares.
